the wild club

A room built from brick, walnut and firelight.

Wildmen sits inside The Arena in Bahria Town Phase 4 — exposed red brick, dark walnut floors, tufted cream seating and warm amber light that never quite lets the night in. It's the kind of room that turns a weeknight dinner into an occasion, and a birthday into a story people keep telling.
